cases.title: Exact baseline mapping
cases.procedure: Verify PC-32473-C-5d25f1744f and LNX-REF-PC-32473-C-5d25f1744f are the sole visible-family control/requirement; PORTRAIT-008 is only related coverage.

cases.title: Neutral import and source identity
cases.procedure: Open/analyse/select with amount zero; require identical pixels, no Rust/model load, no synthetic visible contour and no new effect.

cases.title: Independent visible left arm
cases.procedure: Use a portrait with only left shoulder/elbow/wrist visible; apply left upper/forearm while right remains neutral and no hidden right joint is required.

cases.title: Independent visible right arm
cases.procedure: Repeat with right arm only and inspect the left arm/background for unrequested change.

cases.title: Partial forearm without shoulder
cases.procedure: Use visible elbow/wrist with occluded shoulder; only that forearm operation may be reviewed/applied, without elevating shoulder visibility.

cases.title: Partial upper arm without wrist
cases.procedure: Use visible shoulder/elbow with hidden wrist; upper segment works independently while forearm refuses.

cases.title: Linked all-or-nothing review
cases.procedure: Request both upper segments with one missing review; require total refusal before history/publication and no unilateral effect.

cases.title: Linked matching strategies
cases.procedure: Request bilateral linked SAM while one side only has ordinary review; require total refusal, never manual fallback.

cases.title: Whole-arm simultaneous set
cases.procedure: Set upper/forearm together then split; verify only those segment amounts change and there is no third overall deformation.

cases.title: Original local numerical semantics
cases.procedure: Verify UI 0–100 maps 0–1, positive thins, zero resets, and all numbers/defaults are explicitly local choices.

cases.title: Explicit manual contour measurement
cases.procedure: Review all 18 source cross-section clicks; missing/negative/cross-axis/invalid measurements refuse. Pose centres never supply widths.

cases.title: Actual licensed SAM producer
cases.procedure: With the existing admitted extension installed locally, collect exact model/config/code/runtime receipts and actual masks from canonical source pixels; no new download or silent install.

cases.title: Absent installed model
cases.procedure: Request SAM without its extension; show truthful failure and keep source/manual modes independent. No AI label on a manual fallback.

cases.title: Mismatched model or installed runtime
cases.procedure: Modify test copies of runtime/config/weight bytes; require producer integrity refusal before inference and no fallback.

cases.title: Actual model-input provenance
cases.procedure: Compare input hash against canonical true-bit-depth decoded working-sRGB source, including RGB16 conversion; proxy or retouched pixels must fail replay.

cases.title: Review all actual candidates
cases.procedure: Expose the three unmodified binary candidate masks, candidate IDs and model scores; scores are not arm confidence. Refused candidates remain inspectable.

cases.title: Torso leakage
cases.procedure: Use an actual full-person/torso-leaking candidate. Observed torso core or explicit torso exclusion intersection must refuse; never crop or erase it into an arm.

cases.title: Other-person mask contamination
cases.procedure: Use adjacent people; candidate intersection with other observed body/face boxes must refuse, including selection outside the edited segment support.

cases.title: Ownership window leakage
cases.procedure: Choose a candidate extending outside the explicit arm ownership window; refuse without clipping.

cases.title: No width fabrication from mask failure
cases.procedure: Axis outside selection, holes, multiple disconnected intersections, tiny contour, unbounded ray or low model resolution each refuse; no pose-derived width substitute.

cases.title: Exact source-owned mask replay
cases.procedure: Save/reopen reviewed mask losslessly; require identical mask/input/model receipts and contour widths without claiming a new inference.

cases.title: Mask tampering and foreign review
cases.procedure: Flip packed pixels/hash/padding, import another body/source/segment mask, or submit raw neural widths to review; refuse each.

cases.title: Actual ownership snapshot changes
cases.procedure: Add/reanalyse/remove another observed body or retained source face after proposal; old selection cannot authorize a new arm render.

cases.title: Occlusion and crossing
cases.procedure: Test occluded arm, crossed arms, self-overlap, arm in front of torso and unclear torso-contact boundary; reject affected segment rather than complete hidden anatomy.

cases.title: Strong foreshortening and folded arms
cases.procedure: Test depth-ambiguous/short arms and strong bends; show specific refusal and keep unrelated effects intact.

cases.title: Visible loose sleeve
cases.procedure: Shape only reviewed visible sleeve silhouette; do not claim skin anatomy or fabricate an under-clothing arm contour.

cases.title: Joint and endpoint continuity
cases.procedure: Inspect upper/forearm join at elbow, shoulder/wrist endpoints, oblique axes and contour stations; verify fixed endpoints and C2 taper, without a discontinuity.

cases.title: Rust measured-profile effect
cases.procedure: Change actual reviewed width profile holding axes constant; numerical field must change. Verify positive thinning sign and finite analytical Jacobian.

cases.title: Off-grid composition ordering
cases.procedure: Compose same-BodyRef shoulder, leg if installed, arm segments and face using declared order at displaced coordinates; refuse independently sampled-map addition.

cases.title: Single RGB source sample
cases.procedure: Trace preview and final RGB8/16 sampling; ensure arms do not add an intermediate image warp and receipt sampling_passes equals exactly one.

cases.title: Common semantic/recovery geometry
cases.procedure: Verify semantic/recovery masks and retouch deltas follow the same canonical map as RGB, with no stale source alignment.

cases.title: Independent family preservation
cases.procedure: Combine arm edits with hair, face, shoulder, legs and late-colour settings; their independent values/history/effects must survive arm edits/reset/disable.

cases.title: Support ownership overlap
cases.procedure: Use close bodies/faces and explicit keep-out regions; overlapping conservative arm support refuses without shrinking strength or dropping a field.

cases.title: RGB8 and true RGB16 export
cases.procedure: Export original-resolution RGB8/16 using rebuilt fields and true original source, preserving dtype and bit-depth rather than enlarging a proxy.

cases.title: Preview aspect and source fence
cases.procedure: Use canonical ALIGN8 preview sizes, wrong crop, wrong orientation, wrong source dimensions and new source file; only valid whole-source geometry is admitted.

cases.title: Budget and large photograph
cases.procedure: Exercise model 64MP/2048-edge input cap, packed mask/runtime retention limits, active fields/bodies and common-map budget; no silent truncation or unbounded fallback.

cases.title: Exact publication receipt
cases.procedure: Only actual published map/output bytes may yield a receipt. Missing/mismatched map/hash/source/order/frame/dimensions/sample count must remain failed or uncertain.

cases.title: History and late graph changes
cases.procedure: Undo/redo arm support/recipe/enable without overwriting later arm edits or unrelated body/people/face changes; all assets remain immutable.

cases.title: Project roundtrip and export snapshot
cases.procedure: Save/reopen active, disabled, neutral, undo/redo and queued export trees under project13/bodybank2; validate all owned assets/order before live mutation.

cases.title: Reanalysis invalidates review
cases.procedure: Reanalyse actual pose; retain portable amounts as unapplied intent, invalidate review/support pointers and association, never bind old assets to new point digest.

cases.title: Cross-photo parameter-only transfer
cases.procedure: Transfer requested segment intent only after same anonymous person and target evidence are independently confirmed; masks, points, support and authorization never cross photos.

cases.title: Transfer unsupported target
cases.procedure: Transfer SAM/manual intent to target with hidden arm, wrong strategy support or changed source/people graph; refuse whole candidate and leave target untouched.

cases.title: Cancelled inference and source close
cases.procedure: Cancel during CPU/GPU inference; close document/panel or switch source; terminate owned proposal, free queues/masks and never mutate body state.

cases.title: Lost proposal acknowledgement
cases.procedure: Lose start response; query original request/job ID instead of issuing duplicate inference. Unknown/unavailable result is not successful segmentation.

cases.title: Lost mutation publication
cases.procedure: Lose response after host publication; durable ledger must return authoritative exact request result. UI queries without resending or duplicating history.

cases.title: Rapid gestures and target switch
cases.procedure: Rapid slider changes, strategy/link changes, old body switch and late response must not overwrite newer context. Coalesce only valid unsent intent.

cases.title: Source-overlay review integrity
cases.procedure: Show exact canonical source plus actual mask hash-verified overlay and contour/falloff markers. Failed image/canvas/hash must disable confirmation.

cases.title: Unregistered capability honesty
cases.procedure: Before shared App/native/server registration, no reachable completion claim. After integration verify all real route/command allowlist dispatch and scoped source-path acquisition.

cases.title: No background damage guarantee
cases.procedure: Use patterned garments/backgrounds and inspect transition distortion at final resolution; disclose actual movement and reject unacceptable output rather than claiming zero damage.

cases.title: License and distribution notices
cases.procedure: Confirm existing Apache model/code license notices and original GPL arm source are included by the eventual distributor; no unknown checkpoint or fallback library is packaged.

cases.title: Registered shared portrait chain
cases.procedure: Use a permitted real portrait with active shoulder, leg, one arm, face geometry, hair and late colour; verify one declared off-grid chain and a single common source sampling stage, retaining all independent effects.

cases.title: Canonical SAM replay for RGB8 exports
cases.procedure: Review actual SAM masks from RAW and RGB16 TIFF, then export JPEG/PNG RGB8 and TIFF RGB16. Verify the selection input hash comes from the same true-bit-depth/ICC decoder in both cases, not the output-depth decode.

cases.title: Post-rename journal sync failure
cases.procedure: Inject parent-directory open/fsync/close failure after receipt atomic replacement; verify later status reads the observed content and does not become permanently hash-inconsistent or replay a mutation.

cases.title: Lost terminal receipt write
cases.procedure: Inject a terminal receipt write failure before replacement after successful frame/history publication; query the original pending claim and reconcile only the actual matching authoritative outcome.

cases.title: Invalid publication is not upgraded
cases.procedure: Force publication verification mismatch and terminal journal failure; later status must preserve the rejection and never upgrade pre-verification host success.

cases.title: Cross-family request collision
cases.procedure: Reuse an arm inner request ID already used by shoulder or leg. Verify no arm publication or successful cross-family receipt reconciliation, including a failed final journal write.

cases.title: Read-only capture lifetime
cases.procedure: Keep another valid source capture or semantic review open while reading arm views/status or requesting a proposal; verify no capture invalidation, source mutation or doc revision. Conflicting active workers must visibly refuse admission.

cases.title: Owned model allocation lifecycle
cases.procedure: Start real SAM, close popup/switch photo/start another resource operation/exit engine and verify owned process termination, bounded results, original-ID tombstones, and no unseen model work after cancellation.

cases.title: Project v14 independent persistence
cases.procedure: Save/reopen v14 with reviewed arm masks, shoulder, leg, hair and semantic preset/batch state plus undo/redo history; verify exact source assets and no cross-family overwrite or implicit inference on JSON load.

cases.title: Packaged native ABI and notices
cases.procedure: Build the package locally, inspect staged liblrt_arm_shape.so, original GPL source and admitted SAM/MediaPipe notices, and load the actual ABI without runtime compilation or model downloads.

cases.title: Native epoch and delayed callbacks
cases.procedure: Lose native start/execute acceptance, replace engine/document, query original requests and deliver delayed callbacks; verify no resubmission, stale adoption or orphan model job.

cases.title: Neutral operation identity
cases.procedure: Compare geometry identity before/after installing or reviewing zero arms over shoulder-only and shoulder-plus-leg edits. Preserve v1/v2 order respectively; activate arms to v3 and return exactly to older identity when all are zero.

cases.title: Status after source loss
cases.procedure: Publish an arm edit, remove or replace the source file, then query its original inner receipt. Preserve actual completed outcome without requiring a new view, new decode or replay.

cases.title: One gesture and bounded UI masks
cases.procedure: Drag one slider through many values and verify one gesture history group, latest unsent coalescing and bounded completed/cancelled mask retention. Close and reopen popup without losing uncertain receipts.
